note: Achievements for play only. They are never shown in the teacher view, Turn-in report, PDF/PNG, slideshow, or CSV. No achievement rewards speed, streaks, time played, or repeating the same action; tiers reward variety. Rules are read by js/fun-core.js (metrics, flags, missions). Run python3 tools/make_fun_data.py after editing.

list.name: Rock Reader
list.desc: Identify how your first landform formed.
list.hint: Place a landform and finish its Field Guide picks.

list.name: Landform Collector
list.desc: Identify many different kinds of landforms.
list.hint: Each new kind of landform counts once.

list.name: Force Whisperer
list.desc: Identify landforms shaped by water, wind, ice, and gravity.
list.hint: Four different agents of change. Find them all.

list.name: Break, Move, Drop
list.desc: Identify landforms made by weathering, erosion, and deposition.
list.hint: One of each process.

list.name: Fast and Slow
list.desc: Identify a fast change and a slow change to the land.
list.hint: Watch the time-lapse clock.

list.name: Creature Expert
list.desc: Find the adaptations of many different plants and animals.
list.hint: Each new creature counts once.

list.name: Taught, Not Born
list.desc: Spot a learned behavior.
list.hint: Some animals learn by practice or from their parents.

list.name: Nature's Toolkit
list.desc: Identify a resource, a water feature, a weather feature, and an energy source.
list.hint: Four kinds of features in your Field Guide.

list.name: Everybody Made It!
list.desc: Run a season where every creature in the ecosystem thrives.
list.hint: Try the Survival Season lab with 3 or more creatures.

list.name: Whole-Web Wonder
list.desc: Build a complete food web: producers, consumers, and a decomposer, all thriving.
list.hint: Every eater needs something to eat.

list.name: Lights On!
list.desc: Finish the power grid circuit.
list.hint: A circuit needs a complete path.

list.name: Moon Walker
list.desc: Explain the Sun, Earth, and Moon with spinning shadows.
list.hint: Watch how shadows move during the day.

list.name: Matter Master
list.desc: Finish the materials, mixtures, solutions, and air missions.
list.hint: Four matter missions in Stage 1.

list.name: Biome Hopper
list.desc: Build every kind of biome: desert, grassland, forest, fresh water, ocean, coast, and mountain.
list.hint: Seven biomes in one world.

list.name: World Painter
list.desc: Paint every biome on your island: grassland, forest, desert, tundra, wetland, ocean & coast, and mountain.
list.hint: Use the Biomes tool. Seven biomes on one island.

list.name: Climate Collector
list.desc: Read the climate card for 4 different biomes.
list.hint: Tap the i next to a biome in the Biomes tool.

list.name: Name Giver
list.desc: Give nicknames to different creatures in your card binder.
list.hint: Flip a creature card and give it a nickname.

list.name: Map Maker
list.desc: Name 5 places on your map.
list.hint: Name places when you finish a mission.

list.name: World Builder
list.desc: Build many different kinds of places.
list.hint: Each new kind of place counts once.

list.name: Grand Canyon Builder
list.desc: Line up 3 canyon pieces side by side to make a giant canyon.
list.hint: Canyons can join together.

list.name: Fresh Paint
list.desc: Try a new building skin.
list.hint: Finish a stage to unlock one.

list.name: New Season Look
list.desc: Try a new biome theme.
list.hint: Themes unlock as you play.

list.name: Map Scientist
list.desc: Use the measure tool and the volume tool.
list.hint: Find them in the map toolbar.

list.name: Card Collector
list.desc: Collect Field Guide cards of every kind: landform, feature, and creature.
list.hint: Open the card binder.

list.name: Which Way Is Up?
list.desc: You found the spinning compass!
list.hint: A secret.

list.name: Critter Tickler
list.desc: You tapped a wandering creature and it said hi.
list.hint: A secret.

list.name: Over the Rainbow
list.desc: Help your town after a thunderstorm and see the rainbow.
list.hint: A secret.

list.name: Second Season Charm
list.desc: Fix a survival season that went wrong, then run it again with everyone thriving.
list.hint: Swap or tweak creatures and retry.

list.name: Back on Our Feet
list.desc: Help your world recover from different kinds of world events.
list.hint: Each kind of event counts once.

list.name: Rainmaker
list.desc: Help your world through a dry spell.
list.hint: Dry spells happen when it does not rain for a long time.

list.name: Problem Solver
list.desc: Fix something your world needed, like water or power.
list.hint: Check World Needs.

list.name: City Lights
list.desc: Power your homes so the lights shine at night.
list.hint: Homes need power.

list.name: Second Draft Star
list.desc: Revise a Field Guide entry to make it better.
list.hint: Open an entry and edit it.

list.name: Rethinker
list.desc: Improve the explanation for a mission you already finished.
list.hint: Open a finished mission and edit your explanation.

list.name: Never Give Up
list.desc: Get a Field Guide pick right on your own after a miss.
list.hint: Mistakes help you learn.

list.name: Charter Champion
list.desc: Write your world's charter (its first set of rules).
list.hint: A history event asks for it.

list.name: Compromise Crafter
list.desc: Write a compromise that helps two groups agree.
list.hint: A history event asks for it.

list.name: Amendment Author
list.desc: Write an amendment that changes the rules fairly.
list.hint: A history event asks for it.

list.name: Voice of the People
list.desc: Write a petition or a declaration.
list.hint: Some history events ask for one.

list.name: History Detective
list.desc: Finish history events and compare Then and Now.
list.hint: Each different history event counts once.

list.name: Showtime!
list.desc: Present your world in Present mode.
list.hint: Open the Showcase.

list.name: Tour Guide
list.desc: Plan a full tour of your world.
list.hint: 5 required stops plus one you pick.

list.name: Helpful Critic
list.desc: Give a classmate kind, helpful feedback.
list.hint: Use the visitor feedback form.

list.name: Listening Ears
list.desc: Add feedback a visitor gave you.
list.hint: Import a feedback code in the Showcase.

list.name: Look Back, Leap Forward
list.desc: Finish your Showcase reflection.
list.hint: The Reflection tab.

list.name: Star Picker
list.desc: Star a favorite Field Guide entry for your Showcase.
list.hint: Tap the star on a Field Guide entry.

list.name: Favorite Storyteller
list.desc: Write about your favorites in different stages.
list.hint: Each stage counts once.

list.name: Balanced Budget
list.desc: Balance the town treasury.
list.hint: A Stage 4 math mission.

list.name: Chart Champ
list.desc: Make a chart from your world's data.
list.hint: Try the Data button or a chart mission.

list.name: X Marks the Spot
list.desc: Plot landforms on the coordinate grid.
list.hint: A Stage 1 math mission.

list.name: Genre Explorer
list.desc: Write in different genres: journal, story, proposal, and more.
list.hint: Each new kind of writing counts once.

list.name: Base Camp Builder
list.desc: Finish Stage 1.
list.hint: Every Stage 1 mission.

list.name: Water World
list.desc: Finish Stage 2.
list.hint: Every Stage 2 mission.

list.name: Living Land
list.desc: Finish Stage 3.
list.hint: Every Stage 3 mission.

list.name: Bright City
list.desc: Finish Stage 4.
list.hint: Every Stage 4 mission.
